about_the_game:
Introduction to "Crazy Texas"

"Crazy Texas" is a fun and strategic simulation business game that takes you on a journey from a startup novice to a business tycoon.

In the game, you will step into the business world as a "Market Rising Star" and make a big splash on the business stage of "Crazy Texas". Through the "Market" system, you can keep an eye on the price trends of various goods such as aerial drones, Air sneakers, master calligraphy and paintings, fruit phones, and Bitcoin. Buy low and sell high, make profits from market fluctuations, and accumulate your first pot of gold.

The game has a wealth of functional modules: "Family Talent" helps you unlock unique business buffs; The "Achievement" system records every business breakthrough you make; "Entrepreneurial Resume" witnesses your growth trajectory; "Invite the God of Wealth" adds financial luck to your business path; The "Entrepreneurship" module allows you to develop diverse businesses, the "Spending" system satisfies your consumption desire after business success, and the "Dating" function can add more color to your life.

You need to plan your business moves every year within the age limit of 70, balance the allocation of cash and assets, improve your reputation and health value, and finally make it to the "Rich List", or even choose to "Retire Early" to enjoy the fruits of your business. Come to "Crazy Texas" and create your own business legend!
